input.content:
Biogas plant BGA5 is a small slurry-based farm plant with 75 kW of installed electrical capacity; more than 95 percent of its feed mass is farm manure. A round cast-in-place concrete pre-pit (6 m inner diameter, 3 m deep, approx. 85 cubic metres) collects the cattle slurry from the neighbouring dairy barn and pumps it into the digester with a submersible pump. Solids are charged through a small vertical-mixer feeder with a 12 cubic metre hopper.

Digester F1 is a cast-in-place concrete tank with an inner diameter of 14 m and a wall height of 6 m (gross volume 924 cubic metres). It is equipped with one paddle agitator and one submersible agitator, has internal wall heating and carries a double-membrane roof; the gas space (including headspace) is approx. 160 cubic metres. It runs mesophilically at 38 degrees Celsius (311.15 K) with a fill level of 90 percent. There is no post-digester: the digestate flows straight into the gas-tight digestate store G1 (20 m diameter, 5 m wall height, gross volume 1,571 cubic metres) fitted with one submersible agitator, unheated (approx. 20 degrees Celsius / 293.15 K), fill level 90 percent, gas space including headspace approx. 355 cubic metres.

The biogas from both tanks is converted in a CHP unit with a rated electrical output of 75 kW (electrical efficiency 37 percent, thermal efficiency 44 percent); its waste heat serves the digester and the farmhouse. The gas train is protected by combined over-/under-pressure relief valves. A condensate shaft sits at the low point of the gas pipe.

Substrate feed: approx. 20 cubic metres per day of cattle slurry from the pre-pit into F1 plus 3 t/d solid cattle manure and 0.8 t/d grass silage via the feeder into F1.

T_ad.rationale: mesophil bei 38 C — nicht die 40 C der uebrigen Anlagen

V_gas.note: gasdicht abgedecktes Lager: Membrandach plus Kopfraum

components.note: von add_chp erzeugt; die Anlage selbst hat keine Fackel, sondern nur kombinierte Ueber-/Unterdrucksicherungen

connections.note: kein Nachgaerer: der Gaerrest laeuft direkt ins Lager
